fusions.name: Crook the Stray
fusions.desc: A sweeping crook blow that deals 26 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. On a hit, every ally in your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Drive the Flock
fusions.desc: Drives the haft in a wide sweep ahead of you, dealing 10 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles long and knocking it back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Into the Fold
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Lambing Shelter
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, healing you receives is 40% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
